messages.subject: release of seewave 1.5.9
messages.body_plain:
A new version of seewave (1.5.9) has just been released.

Here are the main changes:

o oscillo(): a new argument 'type' for controlling the type of plot.
Actually useful for no plot (type='n').
o a new argument 'pb' to display a computing progress bar has been added
to functions that can take some time to process.
o a new argument 'fftw' has been added to FFT functions. This argument
can be used to try to speed up FFT process time. The Fourier transform
is computed through the function FFT of the package fftw.

I also added a new graphical example on the webpage
(http://rug.mnhn.fr/seewave/ ; tab EXAMPLES)

Enjoy,

Jerome
